messages:
Eli: Quick holiday idea — 2-minute GIF & mug brag thread. Drop a gif and a pic of your holiday mug/desk ornament. Winner gets the 'Tiny Tinsel' emoji award :tinsel: (totally unofficial)
Priya: love this. starting in 1... :grin:
Jordan: I'll go first — [gif: tiny-dog-in-sweater.gif] here's my travel thermos covered in sticker lights. :sparkles:
Samira: ok adorable. here's my mug (peppermint swirl). gif: pouring-hot-cocoa.gif :candy:
Ava: last-minute entry — gif: fireplace-loop.mp4 and my 'world's messiest hot choc' mug
DevOps Bot: Reminder: please don't upload PII. Uploads are limited to 10MB.
Eli: poll — react :one: for Most Festive, :two: for Most Likely to Spill. Go!
Jordan: adding a pro-tip: put a coaster. also recipe: `microwave 1 cup milk 90s, stir in 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp brown sugar` :yum:
Priya: omg that recipe. bookmarking.
Samira: also — merit for creative gif pairing. Ava gets bonus for 'messy but sincere'
Ava: sending a terrible festive selfie gif. i'm owning it :sweat_smile:
Priya: can't stop laughing. :rofl:
Eli: ok after reactions tally, Most Festive = Jordan, Most Likely to Spill = Ava. awarding Tiny Tinsel to Jordan :tada:
Jordan: thank you, i'll frame this in my mental trophy room :frame_with_picture:
Samira: let's do a micro cookie swap next week? who is in? :cookie:
Ava: yes pls
Priya: count me
Eli: adding to #random calendar — 12/19 lunchtime micro-swap. details later.
DevOps Bot: Calendar event created: 'Micro Cookie Swap (lunch) — 12/19 12:00 PT'.
Jordan: perfect. I'll bring something portable.
Priya: can we also have an 'ugly-mug' photo booth? :camera_flash:
Eli: love it — photo booth at the kitchen table. optional glitter.
Samira: optional glitter always a mistake but yes
Ava: can someone bring napkins? my track record is messy.
Eli: noted. napkins and paper towels on ops list :memo:
Priya: thanks Eli! :heart:
